goal: Generate a 21:9 ultra-wide first screen for high-resolution displays and website homepage tuning, strong dark colors, focused on research and collaboration tools.

left_column.headline: Clarify the problems to make iterations controllable
left_column.subhead: From Backlog to release, seeing dependencies, risks, and resources on a single timeline.

cta.color: Solid electric cyan, weak outer glow 4px

right_column.centerpiece: Two floating unbranded interfaces on a dark panel: the front layer is a draggable issue column, the back layer is an iterative burn-down graph combining line and bar, with a 1px highlight edge
right_column.scale: Occupies 70% of the right side of the frame, slightly sinking into the deep background

background.type: Radial gradient from near black to blue-gray, brightest in the mid-right area.
background.decoration: Extremely sparse 6% brightness dot matrix, simulating a low-light machine room atmosphere.

brand.logo_position: Upper left with small placement of white geometry and text, style close to minimal engineering brands
brand.navigation_hint: No navigation drawing, only leave 8% high safety top edge

safe_area.rule: Bottom margin 8%, rightmost side 4% do not place key elements

must_keep: CTA with sufficient contrast against the background, easily clickable
The total amount of purple and cyan accents in the entire image does not exceed 20% of the frame
No real Git commit hashes or identifiable repository names
avoid: Full frame pure black dead black without gradation
